item.title: Crash between dump truck and SUV reported on I-75
item.description: DAYTON, Ohio (WDTN) – Crews, including medics, were on the scene of a crash between a dump truck and an SUV on I-75 at West Third Street. Montgomery County Regional Dispatch said the call for the crash came in at approximately 2:45 p.m. 2 NEWS is on scene and working to learn more.
